_meta.description: Post-split baseline: measured from the four separate entry points, for tracking future regressions from this point forward. NOT the pre-split measurement — see HISTORICAL_PRE_SPLIT_AGGREGATE in this script and AUDIT_REMEDIATION_AND_RELEASE_PLAN.md 5.1. Re-measured DOWNWARD for the 1.4.x line: gen-locales.mjs stopped embedding `sources`, which was 94% of the locale payload by raw bytes and no rule reads. text 88.7 -> 19.7 KB gzip, yaml 90.6 -> 21.6, html 137.9 -> 68.6, index and markdown 234.7 -> 165.5. The budget now guards a much smaller number, which is the point: re-embedding the citations would trip it immediately rather than hiding inside a quarter-megabyte of prose. Re-measured upward for spec 1.12.0: growth is locale data only (sk, ro, hu, bg, hr), +5.9% raw on `text` and +8.2% on `yaml` because those entries are almost nothing but data; scripts/check-entry-reach.mjs proves no parser reached any entry. Re-measured upward for spec 1.13.0: the `protect` option adds one small module to the `text`, `yaml`, `html`, `markdown` and `index` entries (+1.5% raw on `text`); scripts/check-entry-reach.mjs proves no parser reached any entry. Re-measured upward for spec 1.14.0: growth is locale data only (sr), under 1% raw on every entry. Re-measured upward for spec 1.15.0: growth is locale data only (sl), under 1% raw on every entry. Re-measured upward for spec 1.16.0: growth is locale data only (lt), under 1% raw on every entry. Re-measured upward for spec 1.18.0: the em-paired dash scanner adds one module to every entry (+5.0% raw on `text`, +4.7% on `yaml`); scripts/check-entry-reach.mjs proves no parser reached any entry.
